0 points for customer service at BamBam Bar!
Oct 2024 • Friends
0 points for customer service at Bam!

"Confirmed table text only but we have no table"
That's what the "head booking" at Bam Bam said to me when we had booked in advance but when we arrived at the restaurant, the receptionist had a bad attitude and chased us away.

1/ The attitude of the receptionists was VERY VERY BAD.

When I asked why I had booked in advance and the booking guy had sent a message "confirmed table" but when 7 of us arrived, they said "no table"?
I received a condescending answer with raised eyebrows, no smile: "Wait a moment, I'll ask the head booking to come out and talk to you"
No "yes, sure, miss, sorry, please wait" and no polite smile at all?

After we waited for too long standing in side and didn't see anyone coming, we went to the door to ask again and 20mins later, the head booking came out.
2/ The guy who claimed to be the "head booking" said: "... We just sent confirmed the table by text but that doesn't mean we have a table for you"

"Your table is listed as cocktail table in our booking but that mean no table and you have to stand while holding your drink all night"

"...We can't handle this problem now and i don't know how to handle this situation for you because it's too crowded today. Can you come back tomorrow or another day and I'll give you this or that." ("this or that"???)

I asked to call the manager out to talk but he avoids meeting us too.. Disappointing!

Bam Bam thinks the guest has a need to come to have fun or have to received this kind of terrible management?
- The lack of professionalism and the arrogant attitude of the receptionist?
- The head booking's excuses?
- Or the manager's avoidance of solving the problem?

*** The entire conversation with the head booking and the receptionist's attitude has been recorded so there's no need to deny it***

Written November 1, 2024
